from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter

W, H = 1200, 630
FONT_PATH = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/wqy-zenhei.ttc"

def font(size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_PATH, size)

# Layered, non-uniform midnight-to-indigo background
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#071426")
px = img.load()
for y in range(H):
    for x in range(W):
        t = (0.62 * x / W + 0.38 * y / H)
        glow = max(0.0, 1.0 - (((x - 930) / 620) ** 2 + ((y - 80) / 380) ** 2))
        r = int(7 + 16 * t + 18 * glow)
        g = int(20 + 18 * t + 12 * glow)
        b = int(38 + 42 * t + 43 * glow)
        px[x, y] = (r, g, b)

# Soft atmospheric shapes
fx = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
fd = ImageDraw.Draw(fx)
fd.ellipse((780, -210, 1350, 360), fill=(48, 115, 255, 75))
fd.ellipse((-180, 380, 500, 880), fill=(16, 185, 129, 38))
fx = fx.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(70))
img = Image.alpha_composite(img.convert("RGBA"), fx)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

white = "#F7FAFF"
muted = "#A9B8CF"
cyan = "#68E1FD"
green = "#72F2B1"
card = (255, 255, 255, 18)
stroke = (255, 255, 255, 38)

# Brand pill
d.rounded_rectangle((72, 54, 252, 94), radius=20, fill=(104, 225, 253, 28), outline=(104, 225, 253, 90), width=1)
d.text((92, 64), "HUMMER · 增长战报", font=font(18), fill=cyan)

# Chinese title and subtitle
d.text((72, 126), "让每一次触达，都成为增长", font=font(50), fill=white)
d.text((74, 198), "AI 驱动的全链路营销协同｜本周活动核心数据", font=font(23), fill=muted)

# Accent
d.rounded_rectangle((72, 246, 1128, 250), radius=2, fill=(104, 225, 253, 150))

metrics = [
    ("精准触达", "128,640", "较上周 +24.8%", cyan),
    ("有效线索", "3,286", "转化率 8.7%", green),
    ("预计回报", "¥ 860K", "ROI 4.6×", "#FFC86B"),
]
x0, y0, cw, ch, gap = 72, 286, 330, 190, 33
for i, (label, value, note, accent) in enumerate(metrics):
    x = x0 + i * (cw + gap)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x, y0, x + cw, y0 + ch), radius=22, fill=card, outline=stroke, width=2)
    d.rounded_rectangle((x + 24, y0 + 24, x + 66, y0 + 30), radius=3, fill=accent)
    d.text((x + 24, y0 + 48), label, font=font(21), fill=muted)
    d.text((x + 24, y0 + 85), value, font=font(40), fill=white)
    d.text((x + 24, y0 + 148), note, font=font(18), fill=accent)

# Footer
d.line((72, 538, 1128, 538), fill=(255, 255, 255, 35), width=1)
d.text((72, 564), "HUMMER 智能营销中枢", font=font(18), fill=muted)
footer = "数据更新：2026.09.14"
bbox = d.textbbox((0, 0), footer, font=font(18))
d.text((1128 - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 564), footer, font=font(18), fill=muted)

out = img.convert("RGB")
assert out.size == (1200, 630)
out.save("/workspace/campaign-visual.png", "PNG", optimize=True)
